figurative_meaning_en: A very studious or bookish person
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা কিতাব-কীট, সারাদিন বই নিয়েই থাকে।
আমার ভাই কিতাব-কীট হয়ে গেছে, কোনো খেলাধুলা করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real bookworm, always buried in books all day.
My brother has become a bookworm and doesn't play any games anymore.
note: This idiom draws from the image of insects infesting books, symbolizing excessive devotion to reading in Bengali literary culture.
